column1: Title-screen mood line: "Barcelona, <weekday>, <phrase>." day is MON..SUN or * for any. Hours are Barcelona local, to_hour exclusive; a band may wrap past midnight. Highest priority wins, ties are random.

column5: phrase
LIVE
the first light is still deciding
nobody has spoken yet today
early morning
the early carriages are full of unfinished sleep
everyone is already late
middle of the day
the light is flat and honest
all afternoon ahead
the long slow part of the day
the afternoon is running out
everyone is going somewhere they did not choose
somber twilight
the hour the day admits what it was
the night is getting loud
the last trains are filling up
the madrugada, and still moving
too late to be anything but honest
monday, and the week already weighs something
the longest monday of the month
the week is stuck exactly in the middle
almost, but not yet
a night to finally be free
a night to finally be free
friday refusing to end
a saturday with nothing owed to anyone
the city is pretending it never has to work again
a sunday that stretches too far
sunday dusk, and monday already breathing on it
